verdict.rationale: Metronome is a usage-billing SaaS that stores customer usage and billing data, so an AI-training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI model training, data-use policies, or opt-out controls. The data export and storage documentation concerns a different capability and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
